articles.title: Shop 'til you bot: Google, OpenAI, and the race to build agentic commerce
articles.author: Elizabeth Segran
articles.summary: OpenAI quietly killed its Instant Checkout feature after fewer than 30 Shopify merchants went live, exposing that large language models were never designed for commerce and that bridging the gap between AI models and real-time e-commerce infrastructure is far harder than anticipated. Logicbroker CEO Omar Qari is quoted directly on the failure, and the piece positions Google's Shopping Graph and Universal Commerce Protocol as the stronger foundation, with Gap and Ulta already completing purchases inside Gemini.
articles.tieback: Retailers that cannot surface clean, real-time product data to AI agents lose the sale before checkout is attempted, which is the inventory and catalog connectivity problem that a transactionable presence on LLMs and agents directly solves.

articles.title: Agentic AI in Retail: How Autonomous Shopping Is Redefining the Customer Journey
articles.author: Ruth Lewis
articles.summary: Bain argues that agentic AI is collapsing the traditional multi-step customer journey into a single AI-mediated transaction, splitting the retail landscape into agent-ready merchants who surface structured data and agent-blind ones who do not. Retailers must now compete not just for shoppers but for AI agents as a distinct class of buyer with different discovery, evaluation, and fulfillment requirements.
articles.tieback: Brands whose product catalogs, inventory positions, and order data are not agent-readable become invisible at the moment of purchase, the gap that rapid SKU onboarding and real-time inventory visibility help close for dropship and 3P sellers.

articles.title: Lowe's courts DIY shoppers as AI tools boost online conversions
articles.author: Bryan Wassel
articles.summary: Lowe's Mylow AI shopping assistant now handles more than 1 million customer inquiries per month and drives 3x higher online conversion rates compared to sessions without the tool, while the associate-facing Mylow Companion delivers a 2% improvement in in-store satisfaction scores. CEO Marvin Ellison characterized a well-designed agentic AI experience as a clear driver of purchasing decisions at the Q1 2026 earnings call.
articles.tieback: Retailers reporting measurable conversion lift from embedded AI agents become critically dependent on accurate, real-time inventory signals to fulfill those intent-driven purchases, putting pressure on every link in the supplier data chain.

articles.title: AI in the C-suite vs. on Main Street
articles.author: Susan Lacefield
articles.summary: Drawing on the MHI/Deloitte 2026 Annual Industry Report (61% of supply chain leaders expect AI to transform or majorly improve operations, 65% plan AI investment) alongside a May 2026 YouGov poll (51% of workers worried AI will replace their jobs), Lacefield argues that the optimism gap between the C-suite and the warehouse floor is a management problem that will determine whether implementations succeed or fail.
articles.tieback: Supplier-facing automation that reduces manual EDI work and onboarding friction offers a concrete AI benefits you too story for front-line teams, making adoption stickier across the trading partner network.

articles.title: Agentic coding and the future of supply chain leadership
articles.author: Vincent E. Castillo, Ph.D. and Abhinav Hasija, Ph.D.
articles.summary: Ohio State and Grand Valley State professors argue that AI coding agents are lowering the barrier for supply chain executives to prototype their own decision tools and fulfillment workflows directly from domain expertise, without traditional software development. The article predicts that prototype-and-test will become a core leadership competency while cautioning that generated code still requires rigorous validation and engineering hardening before enterprise deployment.
articles.tieback: Supply chain leaders building custom tooling will prioritize platforms that expose clean APIs and real-time data feeds for inventory, orders, and supplier analytics, making well-documented integrations a meaningful differentiator in vendor selection.
